## Modules

| Key | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Modules.Enabled` | true | true/false | Master switch: false = the mod does nothing at all. |
| `Modules.ProfileTuning` | true | true/false | Apply archetype tuning (reaction speed, riposte chance, attack tempo…) to each NPC's brain modules. |
| `Modules.WeaponRules` | true | true/false | Filter attacks by what the weapon can really do (edge / point / blunt head). |
| `Modules.Variety` | true | true/false | Choose attacks with memory (no more A-B-A-B) and steer the stance to match. |
| `Modules.Feints` | true | true/false | NPCs start attacks they abort and redirect (feints). |
| `Modules.Combos` | true | true/false | NPCs chain several strikes into an interruptible sequence (kata), assuming the first will be parried. |
| `Modules.DefenseReading` | true | true/false | NPCs can fall for (or read) the target's feints and get overwhelmed by sustained parrying. |
| `Modules.CounterAfterDodge` | true | true/false | NPCs counter-attack right after a successful dodge. |
| `Modules.OneHandIK` | true | true/false | Allow archetypes to enable active weapon placement while parrying (stock: off). |
| `Modules.SideDodge` | true | true/false | Allow archetypes to use sidesteps (needs the game's side-dodge animations). |
| `Modules.Calibration` | true | true/false | Measure the real direction of every attack animation at runtime. |
| `Modules.ForceRunOnApiMismatch` | false | true/false | Keep running even if the startup API self-check finds members that moved (not recommended). |

## Assignment

| Key | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Assignment.DefaultProfile` | Soldier |  | Profile used when nothing else matches. |
| `Assignment.ByBrainId` | {HumanEasy=Recruit, HumanMedium=Soldier, HumanHard=Veteran, HumanHardHeavy=Veteran, HumanVIP=Duelist} |  | BrainData id → profile name (stock ids pre-filled). Case-insensitive. |
| `Assignment.ByDifficulty` | {1=Recruit, 2=Soldier, 3=Veteran, 4=Duelist} |  | BrainData.difficulty (1,2,3…) → profile name, used when the brain id is unknown (modded brains). |
| `Assignment.ByFactionId` | {} |  | Creature faction id (as string) → profile name. Takes precedence over brain id. |
| `Assignment.ByCreatureId` | {} |  | Creature data id (e.g. "HumanMale") → profile name. Takes precedence over faction. |
| `Assignment.GlobalLevelShift` | 0 | -6 … 6 | Shifts every assignment along Recruit→Soldier→Veteran→Duelist (e.g. +1 = one step harder, -1 = easier). |
| `Assignment.Ladder` | [Recruit, Soldier, Veteran, Duelist] |  | Ordered list used by GlobalLevelShift. |
| `Assignment.ApplyToAllies` | true | true/false | Also tune NPCs that are friendly to the player. |

## Rules

| Key | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Rules.Enabled` | true | true/false | Master switch of the weapon rules (false = stock attack lists, only class weights stay neutral). |
| `Rules.UnknownWeaponsAreUnrestricted` | true | true/false | When a weapon's damagers cannot be read (modded items), keep the game's stock attack list. |
| `Rules.ReclassifyKindsById` | true | true/false | Reclassify attacks as Swing/Thrust/Bash from their id/address instead of trusting the declared type. |
| `Rules.ReadmitReclassified` | true | true/false | Give the creature the attacks the stock filter dropped only because of a wrong declared type. |
| `Rules.LungeMinRange` | 1.8 | 0.5 … 5 | Attacks whose minRange is at least this are treated as lunges (step attacks). |
| `Rules.ClassBias` | {Sword=…, Dagger=…, Rapier=…, Axe=…, Mace=…, Spear=…, …} |  | Weapon class name → multipliers. Class names: Sword, Dagger, Rapier, Axe, Mace, Spear, Polearm, Staff, Shield, Tool. |
| `Rules.ClassOverrides` | {} |  | Item id → class name, to fix the classification of modded weapons. |
| `Rules.TraitOverrides` | {} |  | Item id → comma list of Edge,Point,Blunt, to declare what a modded weapon can really do. |
| `Rules.DirectionOverrides` | {} |  | Attack id (or address) → direction name (Down, DownLeft, Left, UpLeft, Up, UpRight, Right, DownRight, Thrust). |

## Variety

| Key | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Variety.Memory` | 6 | 1 … 20 | How many of the latest attacks are remembered. |
| `Variety.SameAttackPenalty` | 0.12 | 0.01 … 1 | Weight factor when the candidate is the very same attack as the latest one (decays with age). |
| `Variety.SameDirectionPenalty` | 0.45 | 0.01 … 1 | Weight factor when the candidate travels the same direction as a remembered attack. |
| `Variety.NeighbourDirectionPenalty` | 0.8 | 0.01 … 1 | Weight factor when the candidate is only one 45° step away from a remembered direction. |
| `Variety.NoveltyBonus` | 1.4 | 1 … 4 | Bonus when the candidate's direction does not appear in memory at all. |
| `Variety.NonPlannedWeight` | 0.04 | 0.01 … 1 | Weight given to every candidate that is NOT the planned one when the director steers the pick. 1 = no steering, 0 = only the planned attack can be chosen.  |

## Feints

| Key | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Feints.MinWindowSeconds` | 0.28 | 0.1 … 2 | Feints are not started when fewer seconds than this remain before the damage window opens. |
| `Feints.CancelFractionMin` | 0.35 | 0.1 … 0.9 | The abort happens at this fraction (min,max) of the time before the damage window. |
| `Feints.CancelFractionMax` | 0.7 | 0.35 … 0.95 | Upper end of the abort fraction (see CancelFractionMin). |
| `Feints.ChainDecay` | 0.5 | 0 … 1 | Extra decay of the feint chance per consecutive feint. |
| `Feints.AllowOnLunges` | false | true/false | Allow feints on lunge/step attacks (they move the body; looks worse). |
| `Feints.MaxTargetDistance` | 4 | 1 … 12 | Only feint when the target is closer than this (metres). |

## Defense

| Key | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Defense.ReversalAngle` | 75 | 30 … 150 | A change of strike direction larger than this (degrees) within ReversalWindow counts as a feint. |
| `Defense.ReversalWindow` | 0.35 | 0.1 … 1.5 | Time window (seconds) in which the direction change is measured. |
| `Defense.RequireHitCourse` | true | true/false | Only a strike that was on course to hit counts as a feint when it changes direction (ignores plain weapon waving). |
| `Defense.MinStrikeSpeed` | 1.2 | 0.3 … 10 | Strike speed (m/s) below which direction changes are ignored. |
| `Defense.FooledSpeedFactor` | 0.12 | 0 … 1 | When fooled, the guard is slowed by this factor (0 = frozen). |
| `Defense.ReadSpeedFactor` | 1.6 | 1 … 3 | When a feint is read, the guard follows this much faster for a moment. |
| `Defense.FooledDodgeChance` | 0.35 | 0 … 1 | Chance that a fooled NPC also commits to a dodge (baiting dodges). |
| `Defense.CounterMaxDistance` | 2.6 | 0.5 … 6 | Counter-attack only if the target is within this many metres after the dodge. |
| `Defense.CounterWindow` | 0.6 | 0.1 … 3 | Seconds after the dodge animation ends during which a counter may start. |

## Profiles (archetypes)

Each profile has the same fields. Defaults per archetype:

| Field | Meaning | Range | Recruit | Soldier | Veteran | Duelist |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ParryAdjustSpeedMul` | Speed at which the guard follows the incoming strike (stock 7). | 0.2 … 4 | 0.85 | 1.1 | 1.4 | 1.7 |
| `AboutToBeHitMul` | >1 starts blocking/dodging earlier (stock aboutToBeHitTiming 0.5 s). | 0.4 … 2.5 | 0.9 | 1 | 1.15 | 1.3 |
| `DodgeChanceMul` | Scales the dodge-chance curve (clamped to 0..1). | 0 … 3 | 0.8 | 1 | 1.2 | 1.4 |
| `RiposteChanceShift` | Subtracted from recoilNothingRiposteChance (x and y): positive = more ripostes. | -0.5 … 0.5 | -0.05 | 0 | 0.05 | 0.1 |
| `RiposteDelayMul` | Scales minMaxRiposteDelay: <1 = counters sooner. | 0.2 … 3 | 1.25 | 1 | 0.85 | 0.7 |
| `AttackIntervalMul` | Scales minMaxTimeBetweenAttack: <1 = attacks more often. | 0.25 … 3 | 1.2 | 1 | 0.85 | 0.7 |
| `AnimSpeedMul` | Scales melee animation speed. | 0.6 … 1.6 | 0.95 | 1 | 1.05 | 1.1 |
| `OneHandIK` | Actively place a single one-handed weapon in the strike's path (stock: disabled). | true/false | false | false | true | true |
| `OneHandIKPos` | How strongly (0-1) the hand position follows the strike when OneHandIK is on. | 0 … 0.6 | 0.1 | 0.1 | 0.15 | 0.25 |
| `OneHandIKRot` | How strongly (0-1) the hand rotation follows the strike when OneHandIK is on. | 0 … 1 | 0.5 | 0.5 | 0.6 | 0.75 |
| `SideDodge` | Allow the director to pick sidesteps (needs the game's side-dodge animations). | true/false | false | false | false | true |
| `VarietyStrength` | 0..1: how strongly attack memory shapes the choice. | 0 … 1 | 0.5 | 0.8 | 1 | 1 |
| `FeintChance` | Chance per attack to start it as a feint. | 0 … 0.8 | 0 | 0.08 | 0.18 | 0.3 |
| `DoubleFeintChance` | Chance that a feint is followed by a second feint. | 0 … 0.6 | 0 | 0 | 0.04 | 0.1 |
| `ReactiveFeintBoost` | Multiplier on FeintChance when the target is guarding the zone the attack heads for. | 1 … 4 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.7 | 2 |
| `ComboChance` | Chance, per opening attack, to turn it into a chained sequence (kata) of several strikes. | 0 … 0.9 | 0.25 | 0.4 | 0.55 | 0.7 |
| `ComboMaxLength` | Longest sequence this archetype throws (total strikes, 2-6). | 2 … 6 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 |
| `ComboCommitment` | 0-1: how likely the creature is to keep chaining when the opponent starts a dangerous strike (high = blind commitment, low = breaks off to defend as soon as it is threatened).  | 0 … 1 | 0.9 | 0.6 | 0.35 | 0.2 |
| `InterruptDanger` | Opponent strike danger level (0-1) from which a sequence may be interrupted. | 0.05 … 1 | 0.8 | 0.6 | 0.45 | 0.35 |
| `PressureBias` | Weight multiplier for advancing attacks right after a successful parry (pressing the advantage). | 1 … 4 | 1 | 1.3 | 1.6 | 2 |
| `CounterAfterDodgeChance` | Chance to counter-attack right after a successful dodge. | 0 … 0.95 | 0.1 | 0.25 | 0.4 | 0.55 |
| `FeintReadSkill` | Probability of NOT falling for a feint of the target. | 0 … 0.98 | 0.25 | 0.5 | 0.72 | 0.85 |
| `FooledDuration` | Seconds the guard stays frozen when fooled. | 0.05 … 1.5 | 0.55 | 0.45 | 0.38 | 0.3 |
| `MaxParriesBeforeFatigue` | Parries within FatigueWindow after which the creature gets overwhelmed. | 1 … 20 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 |
| `FatigueWindow` | Length in seconds of the window in which parries are counted for fatigue. | 0.5 … 15 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| `FatigueDuration` | Seconds the creature cannot parry once overwhelmed. | 0.1 … 3 | 1.1 | 0.9 | 0.8 | 0.7 |
| `Jitter` | Per-creature random spread (0..0.5) applied to the multipliers so squads are not clones. | 0 … 0.5 | 0.08 | 0.08 | 0.08 | 0.08 |
